entries.subject: Flegetonte: a corona derived from its magnetic map
entries.finding: The potential field of each map to degree 15, with its source surface at 2.5 radii, reproduces the map with an rms residual of 0% to 0%. X-ray luminosity 1.6 × 10^28 erg/s (2RXS J114543.4+024925, 17.27 arcsec from the star's Gaia position, stellar probability 0.9976); temperature 3.1 million kelvin, not measured: the temperature stars of this X-ray output have (Johnstone & Güdel (2015), A&A 578, A129); mass loss 4.6 times the Sun's, not measured: what the X-ray output suggests (Wood et al. (2021), ApJ 915, 37), uncertain by a factor of 5 or more. The wind passes the speed of sound 2.21 radii out.
